newsitem.title: SPAIN: POLL - Bank of Spain to hold 5.25 pct rate Thursday.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Bank of Spain to hold 5.25 pct rate Thursday.

text.p: The Bank of Spain is expected to hold the 5.25 percent key money market rate unchanged at its regular repurchase auction on Thursday, a Reuter poll showed on Wednesday.
Ten financial experts based in Madrid, London and Barcelona agreed no rate action was seen at tomorrow's repo.
A buoyant economy was the reason.
"Domestic demand and industrial production (are) climbing at a faster-than-expected rate," said Colin Warren at Tokai Bank in London.
The possibility the inflation rate might pick-up from May's record low level, reinforced views the Bank of Spain would leave the rate unchanged, analysts added.

But a few pointed out that European monetary and economic union convergence would prompt another rate reduction in the future. They said time was running out because the short term rate spread is too high and this could pressure the Bank of Spain to cut its official rate sooner than later.
